profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Intuit
profile.summary:
13 years Industry Experience in Software & System development, analysis and support in Executive Compensation, Sales, Pricing and Telecomm Domains.

¬	Application development using Core Java 1.8 (Object Oriented Concepts), Groovy, Grails, Spring Boot, Hibernate, RESTful Web services.
¬	UI development using Angular 5, HTML, GSP, JavaScript, JQuery, Bootstrap. 
¬	Back-end development using Liquibase, MySQL, Flyway, MS SQL.
¬	Testing frameworks JUnit and Spock.
¬	Design and development of new features and new applications with hands-on development, integration and implementation.
¬	Good exposure to development, management and deployment tools like Jira, Jenkins, Bodhi, and Bugzilla.

positions.title: Senior Associate Developer
positions.description:
¬	Application development using Core Java 11 (Object Oriented Concepts), Groovy, Grails, Spring Boot, Hibernate, RESTful Web services.
¬	UI development using Angular 5, HTML, GSP, Typescript, JavaScript, JQuery, Bootstrap. 
¬	Back-end development using Liquibase, MySQL, Flyway, MS SQL.
¬	Testing frameworks JUnit and Spock.
¬	Design and development of new features and new applications with hands-on development, integration and implementation.
¬	Good exposure to development, management and deployment tools like Jira, Jenkins, Bodhi, and Bugzilla.
¬	Coding features based on functional documents, merging code changes into a source code control system such as GIT, SVN.
¬	Coordinating with the Quality Control team members to resolve reported issues. Schedule deployment and testing cycles of new features.
¬	Create, code, test, modify and install programs for a host of applications.
¬	Undertake complex analysis of systems, including diagnosis and correction of faults, and propose solutions.
¬	Recognize process improvement opportunities.
¬	End to end application development involving Requirement analysis, Designing, Building, Testing, Deployment, Implementation and Support activities.

positions.title: Senior Engineer / Analyst
positions.description:
	Perform development, analysis and support functions across a range of development and project activities.
	Liaise with users, business and IT functional areas across Seagate’s regional operations, to understand and document detailed system requirements.
	Assess and provide estimates for development work and project tasks.
	Create, code, test, modify and install programs for a host of applications.
	Undertake complex analysis of systems, including diagnosis and correction of faults, and propose solutions.
	Recognize process improvement opportunities.
	Web development using 
•	Java, J2EE (Servlets, JSP, JDBC)
•	Salesforce basics (SFDC)
	Back-end development using Informatica and Oracle.
	Good International exposure. Worked in countries USA and India. Have worked with offshore employees from India, China, Singapore and Malaysia.
	Onsite offshore co-ordination.
	End to end application development involving Requirement analysis, Designing, Building, Testing and Implementation and Support activities.

positions.title: Technology Analyst
positions.locationName: Hoffman Estates, Illinois. AT&T client office
positions.description:
	Web development using Java J2EE, Spring  MVC, Hibernate architecture.
	Back-end development using Oracle 11.
	Creating, scheduling and monitoring shell script/java jobs on Linux platform.
	Use of Informatica 9.6 for ETL operations.
	Onsite Lead for 4+ team.
	Direct Client interactions.                                     
	End to end application development involving Requirement analysis, Designing, Building, Testing and Implementation and Support activities.
	Work on development tools IBM Rational Application Developer, WebSphere and TOAD.
	Work on ETL tools Informatica 9.6.
	Work with the clients to manage the compliance of SLA’s agreed upon, to ensure timely delivery compliance.
	Coordinate working sessions with various teams for requirements gathering and ensure end to end correctness of data flow.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
	Front-end development using Java J2EE,  MVC architecture.
	Back-end development using Oracle.
	Offshore Lead for 3+ team.                                     
	End to end application development involving Requirement analysis, Designing, Building, Testing and Implementation and Support activities.
	Work on development tools Eclipse and MS SQL.
	Some parts of ETL operations were performed using SAS EG.
	QTP Automation scripts were developed for Regression testing.
	Client Interaction and Offshore Co-ordination.

educations.schoolName: M.H. Saboo Siddik College of Engineering
